hack.root_cause: Unverified User Input — Flash Loan Enabled Approval Manipulation
hack.description: Hedgey Finance lost $44.7M when an attacker used a Balancer flash loan and an unvalidated `claimLockup` parameter to trick the protocol into granting unauthorized token approvals across Ethereum and Arbitrum simultaneously.
